profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer focused on AWS, DevOps & LLM | GDG Brooklyn Lead | Women Techmakers | Trojan
profile.summary:
I am a Software Developer, an Anchor, a Painter, a Guitarist, a Food Blogger and love reading books. You can say, computers have always allured me right from childhood. I was just 11 years old when I encountered coding. As a kid, apart from physical games, I loved playing logical games such as chess and solving puzzles which helped increase my analytical thinking ability. The strong foundation of coding in C spurred my interest in the fascinating world of Computers and also encouraged me to pursue Computer Engineering for my undergraduate study. 

I am one of the core-team members of Google Developers Group (GDG) and Women Techmakers Ambassador. My friends call me an opportunist. I love to try different things around me, explore different domains and it is my curious mind that has led me to success in so many different challenges. 

As an ex-hockey player, I learnt what it takes to be a team player. I desire to be a team-leader in the future, where I can put the collective skills of the team together in order to develop user-friendly and technically sound products. In the future, I see myself having a research position in academia where I can contribute to the understanding of human intelligence and learning.

STAY TUNED to know more about me ;)

positions.title: AVP Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Designing backend services to support the Coder workspace, integrated with Kubernetes for scalable deployment and management
• Architected fault-tolerant BDD testing infrastructure for template deployment leveraging Python, ensuring reliability and consistency across environments
• Collaborated on template deployment pipeline and workspace service integration, leveraging AWS Bedrock for intelligent automation and workflow optimization
• Enhanced system monitoring capabilities by orchestrating Grafana dashboards integrated with Prometheus, leading to improved visibility into system health and performance metrics.
• Set up and maintained Coder infrastructure, ensuring secure, efficient, and consistent developer environments
• Designed and implemented backend services to support the Coder workspace, enhancing reliability by 30% through integration with Kubernetes and utilizing ECS for effective management.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
• Contributed to taking the DEV CLI pilot along with implementing containerization by creating Docker images and pushing to the image registry
• Led a low-level analysis, design, and development of telemetry implementation for DEV CLI utilizing Kafka, ESaaS, OpenShift, and Filebeat to enhance monitoring capabilities
• Mentored a team of 4 new joiners, guiding them through technical designs and project details
• Enhanced configuration management processes across multiple teams by architecting Config Hub as a cross-functional service, which served as a proof of concept (POC) for broader deployment
through the full software development life cycle.
• Optimized security and reduced image vulnerabilities by architecting and developing a Scan CLI tool in Kotlin for scanning Docker images, capturing component telemetry using GraphQL.
•Enhanced deployment efficiency across multiple projects by architecting CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, incorporating HashiCorpVault for managing sensitive configurations, leading to a more streamlined
release process.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
• Developed Barclays Well-Architected (BWA) portal web page in React Typescript along with playwright integration testing 
• Implemented front-end components using MUI (Material-UI) for enhanced UI consistency and performance

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed REST APIs for WebEx Meetings in JAVA Spring-Boot
• Integrated APIs with translation modules, making it more scalable and adoptable to most users around the world 
• Worked on test driven development for the project along with integration testing and unit testing
positions.insights: Skills: JUnit · Scrum · REST APIs · Java · Spring Boot

positions.title: Media Strategist
positions.description:
- Guest Research and Shortlisting on the most suitable guests for the Podcast
- Researching Guest Profiles deeply and preparing Script for the Episode(Questions, Name of Episode)
- Handling changes in the Script and Acknowledgements during live recording with the Guest
- Handling Invite and Thank You emails to Guests
- My voice in Intro and Outro (Thank you note) of the Episodes.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed a site analysis portal for new solar site projects using PythonFlask; automated 30% of work done by employees
• Designed Machine Learning model using Random Forest algorithm to return top 5 sites that are already completed and similar to new site to be implemented based on various parameters
• Researched on different search algorithms such as Random Forest, Catboost and studied company’s working to analyze parameters to optimize output by 40%

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:

using Flask and MySQL database
Deployed complete backend API to serverless AWS lambda along with AWS RDS as database

FilmyBuzz app on Playstore

positions.description: The internship involved various insights into data quality assurance, data integration, model development and various other data analysis tasks.
